# Sample workbook fixtures

**Fake** customer data — not real records. Generated by `backend/scripts/make_fixtures.py`
(the source of truth); regenerate with `cd backend && python -m scripts.make_fixtures`.
Each row/column intentionally carries one data-quality / standardization / update-matching
case from `design.md` §16.3. Spec: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-15-ai-day2-fixtures-design.md`.

## current.xlsx — sheet `Customers`

Columns: `CustomerID` (text, leading zeros), `FullName`, `Country` (standardization source),
`SignupDate` (text — raw date strings), `Active` (boolean-like), `Quantity`, `UnitPrice`
(numeric, feed a formula-based `Total` column), `Notes` (blank column).

| Row | CustomerID | Carries |
|---|---|---|
| R1 | 000100 | exact match to main |
| R2 | 000100 | exact duplicate of R1 |
| R3 | 000200 | needs normalization (`U.S.A.`, `15/02/2023`) |
| R4 | 000300 | invalid date `2023-13-45` |
| R5 | 000400 | unmapped country `Wakanda` (absent from main) |
| R6 | *(blank)* | ambiguous match — `Jane Smith`, two main candidates |
| R7 | 000500 | maps to main 000500 |
| R8 | 000500 | maps to same main row, conflicting fields |
| R9 | *(blank)* | completely blank row (interior) |
| R10 | 000600 | `Active` blank |

Boolean-like `Active` spread: `Y` (R1), `Yes` (R3/R7), `No` (R4/R8), `N` (R5), blank (R10).
Date formats: ISO `2023-01-15`, `DD/MM/YYYY` `15/02/2023`, invalid `2023-13-45`.

## main.xlsx — sheet `CanonicalCustomers`

Canonical master; key = `CustomerID`. Columns: `CustomerID`, `FullName`, `Country` (canonical).

| Row | CustomerID | FullName | Country |
|---|---|---|---|
| M1 | 000100 | Acme Corp | United States |
| M2 | 000200 | Globex LLC | United States |
| M3 | 000300 | Initech | United Kingdom |
| M4 | 000500 | Umbrella Inc | United States |
| M5 | 000700 | Jane Smith | United States |
| M6 | 000701 | Jane Smith | Canada |

`000400` (Hooli) is intentionally absent — R5 has no update match (the unmapped case).

## Deferred

`expected-result.xlsx` + the semantic cell-assertion harness wait for Tools #2–#5 and the
`apply_changes` / `validate_output` workers (separate spec).

# Varied-domain samples

**Fake** data generated by `backend/scripts/make_samples.py` (companion to
`make_fixtures.py`); regenerate with `cd backend && python -m scripts.make_samples`.
Each is a single workbook (no paired master) exercising the quality rules + Tool #1/#2/#3.
Spec: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-20-varied-sample-fixtures-design.md`. All three trip
`duplicate_rows`, `blank_row`, and `type_mismatch`; finance/inventory also trip `blank_column`.

## finance.xlsx — sheet `Invoices`

Demo prompt: *"Add a Total column = Quantity × UnitPrice × (1 + TaxRate), rounded to 2 decimals"* → header `Total` (arithmetic).
Columns: `InvoiceID, Date, Customer, Quantity, UnitPrice, TaxRate, Notes, Memo`.

| Row | Carries |
|---|---|
| F1 | baseline clean row |
| F2 | exact duplicate of F1 |
| F3 | `UnitPrice` thousands-separated text `"1,200.50"` |
| F4 | `UnitPrice` currency text `"$5.50"`; `TaxRate` percent text `"7%"` |
| F5 | `UnitPrice` negative-paren text `"(3.00)"`; `TaxRate` blank |
| F7 | completely blank row (interior) |
| F6 | `Notes` holds literal `=WEBSERVICE("http://x")` (formula-as-data / injection) |

`Memo` is a fully blank column. `UnitPrice` mixes float + text encodings → `type_mismatch`.

## hr.xlsx — sheet `Employees`

Demo prompt: *"Add a DisplayName column: last name uppercased, comma, first name"* → header `DisplayName` (text).
Columns: `EmpID, FirstName, LastName, Department, HireDate, Salary, FullTime`.

| Row | Carries |
|---|---|
| H1 | baseline clean row |
| H2 | exact duplicate of H1 |
| H3 | whitespace `"  jane "` + casing `"SMITH"` |
| H4 | accented name `José Núñez`, `DD/MM/YYYY` date, int `FullTime` |
| H5 | non-latin name `李 雷`; non-numeric `Salary` `"Confidential"` |
| H6 | `Salary` `"N/A"` |
| H8 | completely blank row (interior) |
| H7 | invalid `HireDate` `2023-13-45`; `Salary` blank |

`Salary` mixes integers with `"Confidential"` / `"N/A"` → `type_mismatch`.
`FullTime` is boolean-like noise: `TRUE` / `Yes` / `1` / `N`.

## inventory.xlsx — sheet `Products`

Demo prompt: *"Add a Reorder column: Yes when StockQty is below ReorderPoint"* → header `Reorder` (IF logic).
Columns: `SKU, ProductName, StockQty, ReorderPoint, Price, Discontinued`.

| Row | Carries |
|---|---|
| I1 | leading-zero SKU `"00045"`, baseline |
| I2 | exact duplicate of I1 |
| I3 | numeric SKU `9001` + text `StockQty` `"12"` |
| I4 | `StockQty` blank |
| I5 | `StockQty` negative `-5` |
| I6 | numeric SKU `9002`, huge `StockQty` `1000000000`, currency-text `Price` `"$9.99"` |
| I8 | completely blank row (interior) |
| I7 | `ProductName` injection string `=cmd\|' /c calc'!A1`; text `StockQty` `"50"` |

`Discontinued` is a fully blank column. `SKU` (text identifiers + ints) and `StockQty`
(ints + text) both → `type_mismatch`.

### Running a sample through the pipeline

```
cd backend && python -m scripts.playtest --input ../sample-data/finance.xlsx \
  --prompt "Add a Total column = Quantity * UnitPrice * (1 + TaxRate), rounded to 2 decimals" --header Total
```
(Needs Bedrock creds in the environment — see `playtest.py` header. The quality rules run
without AWS; only the Tool calls need Bedrock.)
